attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 29 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the page, and it prints no hymn and gives no year. The page's note on the name is about the Epicurean philosopher who taught Cicero and about Minos's daughter, not about this man.
